model_description: DINOv2-large backbone (Apache 2.0) with a segmentation head, fine-tuned on hand-labelled 250 m squares in Laredo (130) and Plano (33)
imagery: USDA NAIP 2022, 0.6 m, 4-band (via Microsoft Planetary Computer)
validation_set: 78 random 250 m squares in Plano, hand-labelled blind and never used in training

calibration.method: Combined ratio estimator over 6 land-use strata (label area / mapped area on Blind random squares) times the mapped citywide total
calibration.caution: The survey-only and map-calibrated totals differ by more than their errors; open and park land is thinly sampled. Quote a range.

notes: Precision first: about 9 of 10 mapped square metres are surface parking; the map misses about a third of parking (small lots, apartment parking, lots under trees).
Lots on land with no parcel in the appraisal data (public and exempt land: transit, schools, churches) are kept and flagged exempt; they are less certain (81% precision).
Surface type (paved vs gravel) is not distinguished.
by_confidence_note: Share of mapped area that is parking, by the lot's mean model probability (high >= 0.9, medium >= 0.8, low below), on the same squares as overall
